user_story: As a new user, I want to successfully register for a free online account by filling out the customer registration form so that I can access the banking services. Acceptance Criteria: 1. I can enter my first name in the input with id 'customer.firstName'. 2. I can enter my last name in the input with id 'customer.lastName'. 3. I can enter my street address in the input with id 'customer.address.street'. 4. I can enter my city in the input with id 'customer.address.city'. 5. I can enter my state in the input with id 'customer.address.state'. 6. I can enter my zip code in the input with id 'customer.address.zipCode'. 7. I can enter my phone number in the input with id 'customer.phoneNumber'. 8. I can enter my social security number in the input with id 'customer.ssn'. 9. I can enter a username in the input with id 'customer.username'. 10. I can enter a password in the input with id 'customer.password'. 11. I can confirm my password in the input with id 'repeatedPassword'. 12. After clicking the 'Register' button, the URL should not contain 'register.htm' anymore, indicating successful registration.
